Method of Attack: Memory corruption via env_path_info underflow in PHP-FPM
Remote code execution by manipulating memory and adding custom php.ini values
Impacted Systems: Websites running PHP 7+ versions with PHP-FPM
Websites with earlier PHP versions using vulnerable configurations
Attack Vector: Exploitation of fastcgi_split_path_info directive with a crafted URL
Manipulation of env_path_info to overwrite memory
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of fastcgi_split_path_info directive with specific regex
PATH_INFO variable defined with fastcgi_param directive
Absence of file existence checks like try_files $uri =404 or if (-f $uri)
